reason: The worktree auditor hardcodes Cursor history and treats its absence as inactivity; accept scoped exported history and hold unknown activity for review.

edits.after:
# An explicitly scoped native history export; no export means activity is unknown.
transcripts="${PSTACK_TRANSCRIPTS_DIR:-}"

edits.before: recent=$([ "$last_ts" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null && [ $(( (now - last_ts) / 86400 )) -le 4 ] && echo yes || echo no)
edits.after:
if [ ! -d "$transcripts" ]; then recent=yes
	else recent=$([ "$last_ts" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null && [ $(( (now - last_ts) / 86400 )) -le 4 ] && echo yes || echo no); fi
